question: What condition affects even the wise at the tip of nectar?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar.
There is burning by the essence of juice.
Even the wise one is affected.
inference: Even a wise person experiences burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of juice.
uncertainties: The technical yogic meaning of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa is unclear.
plain_english: Even the wise one is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
